item.title: Iran stages Khamenei photos to mask cracks in IRGC, opposition groups say
item.description: Iranian regime projects strength through staged images of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei at prayers, a senior official with the National Council of Resistance of Iran said.

item.description: The "Melania" documentary surprised members of Hollywood's entertainment media after posting the best opening weekend for a documentary in over a decade.

item.title: Actor John Lithgow defends joining 'Harry Potter' series despite JK Rowling's trans backlash
item.description: Actor John Lithgow called author J.K. Rowling's views on transgender ideology "ironic and inexplicable" considering the themes of her "Harry Potter" books.

item.title: California AG sues hospital that ended gender transition treatment for minors to comply with Trump policies
item.description: California officials are suing a San Diego hospital after it ended gender transition care for minors amid threats from the Trump administration.

item.title: Russia kills 12 Ukrainian miners in deadly bus attack hours after peace talks postponed
item.description: Russian drone strike killed 12 Ukrainian coal miners in what DTEK CEO Maxim Timchenko called an "unprovoked terrorist attack" on civilian workers returning from their shift.

item.title: Portland mayor demands ICE leave city after federal agents use tear gas on protesters 'Sickening decisions'
item.description: Portland's mayor demanded ICE leave his city after federal agents reportedly deployed tear gas and flash-bang grenades on protesters, including children.
